description: This file defines a Fragment class (FragmentMenuFragment) for an Android application, demonstrating fragment participation in the options menu, managing child fragments, and handling check box UI interactions to show or hide nested fragments.

classes.name: FragmentMenuFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages two child fragments and toggles their visibility based on check boxes.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment UI, initializes child fragments if not present, and sets up check box listeners.

methods.name: onViewStateRestored
methods.description: Ensures fragment visibility state is updated after the view state is restored.

methods.name: updateFragmentVisibility
methods.description: Shows or hides child fragments based on the checked state of the check boxes.
